package.name: depth_self_filter
package.description:
Removes the robot's own body from a depth image before nvblox integrates it, so self-structure (e.g. the forward-cantilevered arm) does not appear as a false obstacle in the Nav2 costmap.
INTERIM: the current node is a static near-range cutoff (zeros depth pixels closer than min_range_m). It is a stopgap valid only while the arm holds a fixed pose. The real solution is a URDF-aware self-filter (render the arm's collision geometry from the camera view using joint_states + TF and mask those pixels), which handles the arm moving while driving.
